name: Employee
description: Stores comprehensive information about new employees being onboarded, including personal details, employment information, and onboarding status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Employee's full legal name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Employment start date

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department the employee is assigned to

fields.name: position
fields.description: Job title or position

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: ID of the assigned manager

fields.name: onboardingStatus
fields.description: Current onboarding status (e.g., pending, in-progress, completed)

name: Department
description: Stores organizational department information and their specific onboarding requirements

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the department

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the department

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to the Employee who manages this department

fields.name: description
fields.description: Brief description of the department's function and responsibilities

fields.name: onboardingDuration
fields.description: Standard onboarding duration in days for this department

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the department is currently active

name: OnboardingWorkflow
description: Tracks the overall onboarding process and workflow state for each employee including current step, progress, and completion status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding workflow

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being onboarded

fields.name: currentStep
fields.description: Current active workflow stage (e.g., 'documentation', 'equipment', 'training', 'review')

fields.name: progressPercentage
fields.description: Overall completion progress as a percentage (0-100)

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Date when the onboarding workflow was initiated

fields.name: expectedCompletionDate
fields.description: Target date for completing the entire onboarding process

fields.name: approvalStatus
fields.description: Final approval status (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'in_progress')

fields.name: completionDate
fields.description: Actual date when onboarding was completed and approved

relationships.description: Each workflow belongs to one employee

indexes.description: Ensure one active workflow per employee

constraints.completionDate: Must be null unless approvalStatus is 'approved'

name: Document
description: Store and manage all onboarding documents and forms submitted by employees

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who submitted the document

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of document (I-9, W-4, contract, acknowledgment form, etc.)

fields.name: fileReference
fields.description: Storage path or URL reference to the uploaded file

fields.name: uploadDate
fields.description: Date and time when the document was uploaded

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: Current verification status (pending, verified, rejected)

fields.name: verifiedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who verified the document

fields.name: expirationDate
fields.description: Expiration date of the document if applicable

relationships.description: Each document belongs to one employee

name: EquipmentAssignment
description: Tracks equipment provisioned and assigned to employees during onboarding, including assignment details, condition, and acknowledgment status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment assignment record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the equipment

fields.name: equipmentType
fields.description: Type of equipment assigned (e.g., Laptop, Monitor, Phone, Keyboard)

fields.name: serialNumber
fields.description: Unique serial number or asset tag of the equipment

fields.name: assignmentDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was assigned to the employee

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was returned by the employee

fields.name: condition
fields.description: Current condition of the equipment (e.g., New, Good, Fair, Damaged)

fields.name: acknowledged
fields.description: Whether employee has acknowledged receipt of the equipment

relationships.description: Each equipment assignment belongs to one employee

constraints.uniqueSerialNumber: Serial number must be unique across all equipment assignments
constraints.validCondition: Condition must be one of: New, Good, Fair, Damaged
constraints.returnDateAfterAssignment: Return date must be after or equal to assignment date

name: SystemAccess
description: Manages system accounts and access credentials provisioned for new employees during onboarding

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the system access record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving system access

fields.name: systemName
fields.description: Name of the system or application being provisioned

fields.name: accountUsername
fields.description: Username or account identifier created for the employee

fields.name: accessLevel
fields.description: Level of access granted (e.g., Read-Only, Standard, Admin)

fields.name: provisioningStatus
fields.description: Current status of access provisioning (e.g., Pending, Completed, Failed)

fields.name: provisioningDate
fields.description: Date when the system access was provisioned

fields.name: provisionedBy
fields.description: IT personnel who completed the access setup

relationships.description: Each system access record belongs to one employee

name: OrientationSession
description: Manages orientation sessions for new employees including scheduling, tracking, and completion status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the orientation session

fields.name: sessionDateTime
fields.description: Scheduled date and time for the orientation session

fields.name: sessionType
fields.description: Type of orientation (e.g., 'Company Overview', 'Department Specific', 'IT Systems', 'Safety Training')

fields.name: location
fields.description: Physical or virtual location where the session will be held

fields.name: facilitatorId
fields.description: Reference to the Employee conducting the orientation session

fields.name: attendeeIds
fields.description: List of Employee IDs attending the session (supports individual and group sessions)

fields.name: completionStatus
fields.description: Current status of the session (e.g., 'Scheduled', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')

fields.name: feedbackScore
fields.description: Average feedback rating from attendees (1-5 scale)

indexes.description: Index for querying sessions by date and time
Index for filtering sessions by status
Index for querying sessions by facilitator

name: Notification
description: Log all automated email notifications sent during the onboarding process with delivery status and audit trail

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the notification

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., welcome_email, document_reminder, orientation_invite, equipment_ready)

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address where the notification was sent

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line of the notification

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Date and time when the notification was sent

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Delivery status (sent, delivered, failed, bounced, opened)

fields.name: relatedEntityId
fields.description: Optional reference to related entity (document, orientation session, equipment assignment)

relationships.description: Each notification is sent to one employee

name: User
description: Manages system users including HR administrators, managers, IT staff, and employees with role-based access control

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address used for login and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role for access control (HR_ADMIN, MANAGER, IT_STAFF, EMPLOYEE)

fields.name: departmentId
fields.description: Reference to the department the user belongs to

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

relationships.description: User may be linked to an employee record

name: TaskTemplate
description: Define reusable task templates for standardized onboarding workflows

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task template

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the task template

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the task and instructions

fields.name: defaultAssigneeRole
fields.description: Role or department responsible for completing this task (e.g., IT, HR, Manager)

fields.name: estimatedDurationHours
fields.description: Estimated time to complete the task in hours

fields.name: workflowId
fields.description: Reference to the onboarding workflow this template belongs to

fields.name: dependsOnTaskIds
fields.description: Array of task template IDs that must be completed before this task

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this template is currently active and available for use

relationships.description: Task template belongs to an onboarding workflow
Task templates can depend on other task templates

constraints.defaultAssigneeRole: Must match valid role types in the system

name: Task
description: Represents individual onboarding tasks with tracking of assignment, status, and completion details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name or title of the task

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of what the task involves

fields.name: assignedUserId
fields.description: ID of the user assigned to complete this task

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date by which the task should be completed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current completion status (pending, in_progress, completed, overdue)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the task (low, medium, high, critical)

fields.name: workflowId
fields.description: ID of the onboarding workflow this task belongs to

relationships.description: Task is assigned to a User

name: ApprovalRecord
description: Tracks approval actions required at various stages of the employee onboarding workflow, supporting multi-level approval processes

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the approval record

fields.name: approvalType
fields.description: Type of approval (e.g., DOCUMENT_VERIFICATION, EQUIPMENT_ASSIGNMENT, SYSTEM_ACCESS, FINAL_COMPLETION)

fields.name: approverId
fields.description: Reference to the User who is responsible for providing approval

fields.name: workflowStepId
fields.description: Reference to the specific workflow step or task requiring approval

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current approval status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, ESCALATED)

fields.name: approvalDate
fields.description: Date and time when the approval decision was made

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Approver's comments or notes regarding the approval decision

relationships.description: Links to the user who provides the approval
Links to the workflow task requiring approval
